title: Automotive Brakes/Suspension, Transmission/Drive Train Technician
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Automotive Brakes/Suspension Transmission/Drive Train Technician – Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Given an in-class exam, based on readings, classroom discussions and demonstrations, take a Pass/No Pass practice exam, or an official ASE Certification Test exam with a grade equivalent of "pass."
Develop knowledge and skills for job entry positions in the automotive field.
Working in the field, will develop updated knowledge and skills in the automotive field.

notes: Program outcomes are printed once under the AUTOMOTIVE TECHNOLOGY program heading (page 76) for 'the degree or certificate program'; this certificate shares that list, so it is recorded here.

The Automotive Technology description names entry 'as a technician in automotive service, repair, tune up, smog certification, or automotive air conditioning' but only for a student 'completing degree requirements'; the certificate's own section names no careers, so careers is left empty. A reviewer may decide whether those apply.

A separate Certificate of Accomplishment 'Automotive Brakes and Suspension Technician' (ATEC 114, 116; 8 units) and 'Automotive Transmission and Drive Train Technician' (ATEC 134, 135; 8 units) appear on page 78; they are different awards and not recorded here.
